technique_name: Describe your experience with the given product.
description: I have been using Google Docs for the past few years for my school and work projects. It has been a great tool for me to create, edit, and collaborate on various documents with others. I love how easy it is to use and how easy it is to share documents with others. The ease of use has made it a go-to tool for me.
